necessary_context.content: Unknown convex G-Lipschitz f on known nonempty closed convex X; known mu-strongly convex r with h=r+indicator_X proper closed convex and exact prox_eta_h for every eta>0. F=f+r has minimizer x* with supplied feasible x1 satisfying ||x1-x*||<=D. Fresh query-dependent subgradient kernels satisfy separate conditional centered norm-p and directional-p moment bounds L^p and s^p. E_T^(mu)(delta) is minimax 1-delta objective-error quantile risk, not expected loss.
